overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for UiO. None of the 10 sampled plans has personal data or admin dates left. Across all 47 offerings, the current code removes the staff names UiO pages do hold ('Ta kontakt med <navn> eller <navn>' in FYS5930L, '<navn> (<e-post>)' in GEO5930L/MAT5930L); the leak an earlier audit reported is gone, also from the published course_plans.RDS. The exam-links footer is cut exactly in every offering (Bokmål, Nynorsk and English), with no course text after it; both name_like flags are false alarms (APA manual title, English course titles 'Thesis Writing for … American and British Studies'). The only defect is cosmetic: an e-mail removed mid-sentence leaves a stray space or a phrase with no object.

findings.evidence: ikke er meldt til studieadministrasjonen , før forelesningen starter.
findings.description: The functional address studieinfo@ibv.uio.no is removed, which the rubric allows, but the space before it stays, so the plan reads 'studieadministrasjonen , før'. In the sample this is the only removal outside the footer. Across all 47 UiO offerings, 8 have an e-mail removed mid-sentence, all of them department or programme addresses (studieinfo@…, lektorprogrammet@ils.uio.no), not personal ones. Outside the sample the same gap leaves phrases with no object: 'Dette gjøres via e-post til .' (PROF3025), 'meldt Fysisk institutt på  før' (FYS1120L, FYS5810), 'Ta kontakt med  for å få mer informasjon' (BIOS5930L). No content is lost and nothing personal is left, so this is cosmetic.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_generic() (R/anonymize.R), the bare-email rule str_remove_all("\\b[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\\b") removes only the address. The space before it stays, and the final cleanup trims only trailing spaces at the end of a line and runs of blank lines.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic(), let the bare-email rule also remove the horizontal space before the address: str_remove_all("[ \\t]*\\b[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\\b"). That gives 'studieadministrasjonen, før' and 'via e-post til.', and it leaves addresses at the start of a line alone. Add a case to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R: 'meldt til adm x@uio.no, før' -> 'meldt til adm, før'. A '[e-post]' placeholder would keep sentences readable, but it changes what the data mean, so it needs a methods.qmd decision.
